rationale: Jesus introduces the words with an explicit quotation formula -- "Have you not read that from the beginning the Creator 'made them male and female,' and said" -- and then quotes Genesis 2:24 in wording the shipped BSB corpus confirms is nearly verbatim ("a man will leave his father and mother and be united to his wife, and they will become one flesh" against Matthew's "...and the two will become one flesh"). That formula, not shared vocabulary alone, is why this is graded quotation/explicit. Jesus also quotes Genesis 1:27 ("male and female") in the same breath, which sits outside this lesson's own passage and outside this row's range. Mark 10:6-9 carries the same two-part quotation in near-identical wording and is not separately authored here as its own row.
